messages:
tara-docs: Quick heads-up: I opened a PR to combine Dedicated provisioning + autoscale tips into one migration guide (https://git.redwood/docs/pull/513). Need a tiny k8s annotation example, a minimal TF + Python autoscale snippet, and a short SLA exemption line.

sam-eng: I can add TF + Python. prefer inline TF resource so readers can copy paste. will include burst_capacity.

oliver-infra: k8s snippet: annotate pods with `redwood/tenant-id` and `redwood/reserved=true`. note for OSS installs: priorityClass may be `high-priority` instead of `redwood-dedicated`.

jenna-techwriter: drafting SLA sentence now. legal wants explicit exclusions for cloud preemption and operator drains. propose: "Evictions resulting from cloud preemption, platform maintenance, operator-initiated drains, or tenant misconfiguration are excluded from SLA credits."

chris-sre: agree. also add example: "Exempt: spot instance reclaim during provider maintenance."

sam-eng: TF inline example (short):
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_autoscale_policy" "demo" {
  tenant_id    = "tenant-42"
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 5
  cpu_target   = 70
  burst_policy { enabled = true, burst_capacity = 1 }
}
```

sam-eng: Python one-liner: `policy = DedicatedClient().create_autoscale_policy("tenant-42", min_replicas=1, max_replicas=5, cpu_target=70, burst_capacity=1)`

tara-docs: perfect. small perf note from infra: autoscale cold-starts can add ~200-500ms KV-cache warmup; recommend min_replicas>0 for strict p99s. jenna please add the two OSS notes and merge once docs-bot linkcheck is green.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken link found (/docs/old/dedicated-module). CI blocked.

jenna-techwriter: removed the legacy link in branch and pushed. requesting linkcheck re-run.

docs-bot: linkcheck re-run requested by jenna-techwriter. queued.
